parameters.content:
## GD·03 Publish: draft (Boss 5 · D4, from 5.4)
Fridays 14:00: next week's calendar rows + CURRENT product prices and photos → AI writes one version per platform (Instagram, Facebook, X; add more in the prompt) → CODE checks each platform's rules (Instagram needs a photo, X ≤ 280 characters, banned phrases, prices must match today's price list) → saved → Tolu approves each calendar item on Telegram. Blocked versions never reach approval.

Tables: calendar(id, post_date, post_time, pillar, idea, product_sku, media_url, status), posts(id, calendar_id, platform, caption, alt_text, media_url, uses_price, price_snapshot, status, scheduled_at, post_id, published_at), products(sku, name, price_ngn, unit, in_stock, photo_url), settings (brand_voice, banned_phrases).
**Credentials:** Postgres, OpenAI, Telegram. **Replace:** YOUR_MODEL, YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.

parameters.query:
SELECT c.id, c.post_date, c.post_time, c.pillar, c.idea, coalesce(c.media_url, p.photo_url) AS media_url,
       p.name AS product, p.price_ngn, p.unit, p.in_stock,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'brand_voice') AS brand_voice,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'banned_phrases') AS banned_phrases
FROM calendar c LEFT JOIN products p ON p.sku = c.product_sku
WHERE c.post_date BETWEEN current_date + 3 AND current_date + 9 AND c.status = 'planned'
ORDER BY c.post_date, c.post_time;

messageValues.message:
=You write social posts for Harvest Lane, fresh produce delivered in Ibadan. Brand voice: {{ $json.brand_voice }}
Write one version each for instagram, facebook and x. Use only the price given, exactly, or no price. X captions must be under 250 characters including hashtags. Alt text describes the photo plainly. Return JSON only.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO posts (calendar_id, platform, caption, alt_text, media_url, uses_price, price_snapshot, status, scheduled_at)
SELECT $1, v->>'platform', v->>'caption', v->>'alt_text', $3, (v->>'uses_price')::boolean, $4::int,
       CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length(v->'problems') = 0 THEN 'pending' ELSE 'blocked' END,
       ($5::date + $6::time) AT TIME ZONE 'Africa/Lagos'
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) v
RETURNING id;

WITH u AS (UPDATE posts SET status = 'skipped' WHERE calendar_id = $1 AND status = 'pending' RETURNING id)
UPDATE calendar SET status = 'skipped' WHERE id = $1 RETURNING (SELECT count(*) FROM u) AS skipped;
INSERT INTO events (workflow, lead_id, event, detail) VALUES ('GD·03', $1, 'success', $2::jsonb);
